name: GetMattered
tagline: Find matched jobs and apply on the employer's own hiring system, with a resume tailored to each role
description: Hosted MCP server for job seekers. Find jobs matched to your resume, score your resume against a posting, tailor the resume and cover letter for each role, and apply on the employer's own hiring system across 30+ hiring systems, including Workday, Greenhouse, Lever and iCIMS. Send each application automatically or hold it for your approval, track which employers confirmed receipt, read and answer employer emails, manage follow-ups, and prepare for interviews. Sign in once with OAuth; no API key.
